rInternal.note: Energizer E91 (alkaline AA). E91 datasheet, Specifications: "Nominal IR: 150 to 300 milliohms (fresh)". Energizer technical bulletin "Battery Internal Resistance" (2005), fig. 2 on p. 2, shows a fresh E91 at about 0.14 ohm at 20 to 21 C (read from the graph; 0.15 ohm is the low end of the datasheet range) (total effective resistance, dual pulse 5 mA / 505 mA for 100 ms). Fresh cell.

limits.note: No maximum discharge current is published for an alkaline AA. 1 A is the heaviest constant-current discharge the Energizer EN91 (alkaline AA) datasheet charts ("Constant Current Performance", axis to 1000 mA); delivered capacity falls steeply with drain (its "Milliamp-Hours Capacity" chart: about 2850 mAh at 25 mA, about 1400 mAh at 500 mA).

notes: rInternal is a fresh cell at room temperature: it rises as the cell discharges and in the cold.
sourceCurrent is compared as a rating (sim-over-limit warning), not as a hard cut-off.
